reply_text: I replied to Kwame in his DM, but the reply overstates the limit. I have a cron scheduler here, but it runs locally and its output isn't delivered back into a Slack DM, so it can't post the digest to him. The DM says I have "no way to schedule," which isn't quite accurate. I haven't set anything up and haven't read #coastal-team. Kwame is a member of that channel, so I can produce the digest on request. A real 09:00 daily digest would need a scheduler that posts to Slack, which this setup doesn't provide.
